senses.gloss: तृच॑ m. n. (fr. त्रि॑ and ऋ॑च्, Pāṇ. vi, 1, 37, Vārtt. 1) a strophe consisting of 3 verses, AV. xix; TS. i; AitBr.; ŚBr. & KātyŚr. (त्रिच॑), Nir.; RPrāt.
तृच—कॢप्त mfn. arranged in strophes of 3 verses each, ŚāṅkhŚr.; AitBr. iii, 43; Sāy.
तृच—भागा f. (scil. ऋच्) verse 1. of the 1st, v. 2. of the 2nd, and v. 3. of the 3rd पर्याय of a Tṛca, Lāṭy. vi.
तृचिन् mfn. containing a Tṛca, AitBr. iii, 43.
